+@pytest.mark.filterwarnings('ignore:default contamination')
+@pytest.mark.filterwarnings('ignore:behaviour="old"')
+def test_warm_start():
+    """Test that warm_start=True adds more trees on repeated fit calls."""
+    X = iris.data
+    y = iris.target
+
+    clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=5, warm_start=True, random_state=0)
+    clf.fit(X)
+    assert len(clf.estimators_) == 5
+
+    clf.set_params(n_estimators=10)
+    clf.fit(X)
+    assert len(clf.estimators_) == 10
+
+    # Without warm_start, fit resets the estimators
+    clf2 = IsolationForest(n_estimators=5, warm_start=False, random_state=0)
+    clf2.fit(X)
+    assert len(clf2.estimators_) == 5
+
+    clf2.set_params(n_estimators=10)
+    clf2.fit(X)
+    assert len(clf2.estimators_) == 10  # reset to 10, not additive
